subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Lucky Seven
description: A quick, practical guide to Lucky Seven.

hook.text: Slot machines use three sevens as the jackpot. Las Vegas built an empire on a Babylonian superstition.

buildup.text: Seven is considered lucky in most Western cultures. Gamblers, athletes, and brides invoke it constantly.

discovery.text: The luck of seven may trace to dice. In craps, seven is the most common roll with two dice—six combinations.

twist.text: In Chinese culture, seven is unlucky because it sounds like the word for 'deception.' Same number, opposite meaning.

climax.text: Lucky or unlucky, seven grabs attention. Its power comes from cultural weight, not probability.

punchline.text: Same number. Different culture. New meaning.

quiz.question: Why is seven often considered lucky in Western culture?
options: Religious and astronomical significance gave it cultural weight
